title: 第一卷 风起时 第九章 邋遢少女大人第一卷 风起时 第十章 怒
content_zh:
;;
自小在百丈山长大的陈风奇，吃的从来都是山间瓜果。
大概是有应劫之物存在的关系，导致百丈山生机不绝，影响了植被的生长，倒是不会缺少食物来源。
可关于鸡鸭鱼肉等，那些千年前再平常不过的食物，却是从来没有尝过。
他只在一些古籍中看到过记载。
尤其是在百丈山内，还留存了一些古菜谱，其中记载的各种食材，各种菜肴，被描写得天花乱坠，美味至极。
这让从来没有吃过的他，充满了好奇。
俗话说，悠悠万事，吃饭为大。
在六欲之中，就有食欲，乃是人之根本，割舍不去。
追求味蕾的满足感，更是生物本有的天性。
这一点，连仙人也不例外。
仙人辟谷，却避不开人间的至臻美味。
陈风奇也没想到，千年光阴，在这个结绳村内，竟然还有鱼存在。
他下意识转头，看向了那个巨大湖泊，不由咽了咽唾沫。
虽然百丈山的瓜果味道也很不错，可他吃了整整十八年，就算味道再好，味蕾也有些麻木了。
陈航三人看他那副模样，不禁好笑，可又都能够理解。
如今世界，早已经不是千年前，有的避风村内生存环境差，被饿死的也不在少数。
甚至可以说，避风村的存在，本就是一个奇迹，是先圣古贤们对世人的庇佑。
他们还能苟且活着，就很不错了。
这句话残酷，却也真实。

然而就在此时，远处突然传来的一声巨响，让几人神色骤变。
当他们转头看去，更是被惊得脸色煞白，没一个敢动的。
只见在那房屋废墟之上，此刻多了一头异兽。
更准确地说，那是一具异兽尸体。
而在异兽的尸体上，还站着一位少女。
她身披布条斗篷，长发乱糟糟的，正是之前陈航几人在低谷遇到的那位邋遢女。
“她怎么也来了！”
几人心中叫苦不迭，却一点也不敢轻举妄动。
他们是见识过邋遢女厉害的。
当时对方所带来的那种震撼与压迫感，可比异兽强多了。
此刻生怕一个动作让这位邋遢少女大人不满，给自己来上那么一下，那真是会要命的。
邋遢女在闯入结绳村后，先是简单打量了一下四周环境，随后才看向了陈风奇四人。
这简单的一眼，直接就让几人的心提到了嗓子眼。
但好在，对方只是简单扫了一眼，就略过了，似并不在意几人。
她的眼中，也没有表现出明显的善意或是恶意，倒是莫名给人几分野兽的既视感，吃素的那种。
随后，她看向了湖泊中央的巨大麻球，又伸手抓住异兽尸体，在地上一个起跳，就稳稳落到了麻球上方的最中央。
陈风奇几人看得是目瞪口呆，头皮发麻，只觉对方真的太生猛了。
这轻轻跳一下，就至少得有百丈远了吧？
并且在她手里，还抓着一头体型超过了两丈的异兽。
陈风奇甚至觉得，她是不是都快会飞了？

在修行古籍上就有记载，当修士突破凝气，踏入筑基后，就可以做到踏空飞行。
乃至于，若是凝气修士习得一些飞行术法，也同样可以实现飞空。

Chen Fengqi, who grew up in Baizhang Mountain, has always eaten fruits from the mountains.
Probably because of the existence of things that should be catastrophic, Baizhang Mountain is constantly full of vitality, which affects the growth of vegetation, but there is no shortage of food sources.
But as for chicken, duck, fish and other foods that were commonplace thousands of years ago, I have never tasted them.
He had only seen records in some ancient books.
Especially in Baizhang Mountain, some ancient recipes have been preserved. The various ingredients and dishes recorded in them are described in a colorful and extremely delicious way.
This made him full of curiosity as he had never eaten before.
As the saying goes, of all things, eating is the most important thing.
Among the six desires, there is appetite, which is the root of human beings and cannot be given up.
It is the biological nature to pursue the satisfaction of taste buds.
Even immortals are no exception to this.
Immortals live without food, but they cannot avoid the most exquisite delicacies in the world.
Chen Fengqi also didn't expect that for thousands of years, there would still be fish in this Jiesuan Village.
He subconsciously turned his head and looked at the huge lake, swallowing his saliva.
Although Baizhang Mountain's melons and fruits tasted very good, he had been eating them for eighteen years, and no matter how good they tasted, his taste buds were a little numb.
Chen Hang and the other three couldn't help but laugh when they saw his appearance, but they all understood.
Today's world is no longer the same as it was a thousand years ago. The living environment in some shelter villages is poor, and many people starve to death.
It can even be said that the existence of Shelter Village is a miracle, and it is the blessing of the ancient sages to the world.
It's great that they can still survive.
This sentence is cruel, but also true.
However, at this moment, a loud noise suddenly came from the distance, causing the expressions of several people to change suddenly.
When they turned around to look, their faces turned pale with shock, and no one dared to move.
I saw a strange beast on top of the ruins of the house.
To be more precise, it was the corpse of a strange beast.
And on the corpse of the alien beast, there was a young girl standing.
She was wearing a cloth cloak and her long hair was messy. She was the sloppy girl that Chen Hang and the others met in the trough.
“她怎么也来了！”
Several people complained in their hearts, but they did not dare to act rashly.
They have seen how powerful sloppy girls are.
The shock and oppression brought by the other party at that time was much stronger than that of the alien beast.
At this moment, I was afraid that a move would make this sloppy girl dissatisfied. If she were to do that to myself, it would really be fatal.
After breaking into Jiesuan Village, the sloppy girl first briefly looked at the surrounding environment, and then looked at Chen Fengqi and the others.
This simple glance directly made several people's hearts rise in their throats.
But fortunately, the other party just glanced at them briefly and ignored them, as if they didn't care about them.
There was no obvious kindness or malice in her eyes. Instead, she gave people the sense of a beast, the vegetarian kind.
Then, she looked at the huge sesame ball in the center of the lake, reached out and grabbed the corpse of the alien beast, jumped up on the ground, and landed firmly in the center above the sesame ball.
Chen Fengqi and the others were dumbfounded and their scalps were numb. They felt that the other party was really too fierce.
With a slight jump, it must be at least a hundred feet away, right?
And in her hand, she was holding a strange beast that was over two feet tall.
Chen Fengqi even thought that she would soon be able to fly?
There are records in ancient spiritual books that when a monk breaks through the Qi Condensation and steps into the foundation, he can fly through the air.
Even if a Qi Condensation monk learns some flying techniques, he can also fly in the air.
